title: Hydrogen transition energy
hints: Compute the ending value minus the starting one.
Verify the sign for an upward transition.
statement:
Use $E_n=-2.179\times10^{-18}/n^2$ J. What is the atom’s energy change for $n=2\to4$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Final minus initial is positive for absorption.
This is the energy to ionize from n=2.
This is the magnitude of the n=4 level.
